Page 286 Cont.
July 2 Frank Delaney - 60 - Cancer of throat Hugh M S Millan - 65 - operation 9 & 18 of June Nancy Louise Kleefuss - 32 - lukemia feard ..... (See Sept. 14) Ed Cummings - 74 - Lukemia
4 Rose Mahon - 66 - 2 operations since last Sept. - Complication be- sides - now fears necessity of further cperations.
Casimir Zalewski - 46 - fearful Eczima - has wife and four small children - finds it hard .... Enrolled Today in Ser. Masses. Promises at least weekly Comm'n instead of twice in yr.
Page 287
July 3 Clifford Dalka - 22 - Hodgskin's disease, started about a year ago with glands in neck; was robust and healthy .... has had 5 transfusions of blood ... Mother promises to make Easter Duty etc.
3 Thanks - Wm. Bliss - 19 - kicked by horse April 19th - Unconscious with fractured skull for 12 week - prayers were asked for by phone and enrollment; improvement started at once; is here To-day on way home from hospital seemingly out of danger.
5 Frank Joos - 21 - seemingly in fair health and physically normal but no pep whatever to work at anything.
Florence Mrs. Miller - 32 - Ostamalitis - Mother of two little girls; remembers her father had her arm taped when she was a very small girl. Off and on it has bothered her but of late it has become serious. An X-ray shows quite a patch of both wrist bones decayed ... operation feared necessary .... Enrolls To-day promising more frequent Communion.
Page 288 July 8 Dolores Wojtyna - 15 - T.B. and fever
Geo. Baker - 40 - operation To-day in Ann Arbor - has wife and 6 .... Edwin Baker - 48 - Stroke and speechless.
Mrs. Kathleen Candon - T.B. patient in Kiefer's who is blind and ex- pecting operation Tomorrow , July 9th - has plurisy too.
